name: JOOLA Solstice Sun Hoodie
description: The JOOLA Solstice Sun Hoodie is a lightweight long-sleeve hoodie rated UPF 50+ for outdoor play in strong sun. Its quick-dry, moisture-wicking knit and thumbhole cuffs keep hands and forearms covered, and a scuba-style hood fits over a visor for extra neck protection.

specifications.features: Thumbhole cuffs, scuba-style hood, flatlock seams

care_instructions: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle with like colors. Do not use fabric softener, which reduces moisture wicking. Tumble dry low or hang dry. Do not iron the printed logo.
